_comment: Project settings for EvidenceBasedDB. Hooks seeded 2026-09-14 from hsbc-quantum-fraud-2026, then converted from PowerShell to Python 2026-09-14 (QUALITY_STANDARDS.md amendment, same date) so they run unmodified on any OS. Command strings use FORWARD slashes only -- both python and ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR} accept them on Windows, which removes the doubled-backslash JSON-escape hazard test_hook_registration.py was written to catch; that test still runs against whatever separator style is present. The three hooks guarding hsbc's frozen submission artifacts were deliberately NOT carried; they guard files that do not exist here.
